poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE WEIGHT OF WORDS UNTOLD AND THE SHADOWS WE CAST
poetryFrame.rightVertical: THIS NECESSARY SPACE IS WHERE TRUTHS FINALLY BLOOM
poetryFrame.bottomLine: DISTANCE IS THE ONLY WAY TO FIND PEACE
sonnetLines: The gentle ache of what might have been,
We built a fragile house on shifting sand,
Held by the promise of an open hand.
But clarity arrives with chilling grace,
To show the truth within this lonely space.
Leaving only silence and cold despair.
The ringing call, a ghost upon the line,
A memory that was never truly mine.
We must retreat to find our separate light,
And face the morning after endless night.
Let distance be the keeper of the vow,
To finally learn how to live here and now.
